title: Sauna heat-up

panels.title: Heat-up curves (minutes from the first heating sample; one line per run)

targets.rawSql:
select (extract(epoch from s.ts - r.started_at) / 60)::float as minutes, s.temp_c::float as temp_c, r.id::text || ' ' || coalesce(r.phase, '-') || ' ' || coalesce(r.mode, '?') || ' b' || coalesce(r.bench_pct::text, '?') || ' c' || coalesce(r.ceiling_pct::text, '?') as run
            from sauna_samples s join sauna_runs r on r.id = s.run_id
            where r.started_at > $__timeFrom() and s.ts < r.started_at + interval '3 hours' order by r.id, s.ts

panels.title: Phase A: simple vs learning, run by run (A2 in order, so drift reads top to bottom)

targets.rawSql:
select phase, plan_seq as seq, mode, to_char(started_at at time zone 'America/Chicago', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') as started,
                  start_c, t_80_min, t_target_min, overshoot_c, tail_slope, settle_sd,
                  case when ended_at is null then 'heating' when valid then 'ok' else coalesce(invalid_reason, 'invalid') end as status
           from sauna_runs where phase in ('A1', 'A2') order by phase, plan_seq, started_at

panels.title: Minutes to target by setup (valid runs; the bars are means, the table below has each run)

targets.rawSql:
select mode || ' b' || bench_pct || ' c' || ceiling_pct as setup,
                  round(avg(t_target_min), 1)::float as "to target", round(avg(t_80_min), 1)::float as "to 80",
                  count(*)::int as runs
           from sauna_runs where valid and not adaptation_run and mode is not null
           group by 1 order by 2

panels.title: Start temperature vs minutes to target (every finished run; the scheduling estimate)

targets.rawSql:
select start_c::float as start_c, t_target_min::float as "to target", coalesce(mode, 'unlabelled') as mode
           from sauna_runs where t_target_min is not null and start_c is not null order by start_c

panels.title: Effects (from sauna-analysis.py; empty until phase B has runs)

targets.rawSql:
select phase, response, term, round(estimate, 1) as estimate, round(low, 1) as low, round(high, 1) as high, n,
                  to_char(fitted_at at time zone 'America/Chicago', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') as fitted
           from sauna_model order by phase, response, term

panels.title: Overshoot and tail slope by mode (valid runs)

targets.rawSql:
select mode, round(avg(overshoot_c), 1)::float as "overshoot C", round(avg(tail_slope), 2)::float as "tail slope",
                  round(avg(settle_sd), 2)::float as "settle sd"
           from sauna_runs where valid and mode is not null group by mode order by mode

panels.title: Runs, newest first (invalid ones say why; adaptation runs are recorded but not scored)

targets.rawSql:
select id, to_char(started_at at time zone 'America/Chicago', 'MM-DD HH24:MI') as started, phase, plan_seq as seq, mode,
                  bench_pct as bench, ceiling_pct as ceiling, adaptation_run as adapt, start_c, t_80_min, t_target_min, overshoot_c,
                  tail_slope, settle_sd, peak_c, end_state,
                  case when ended_at is null then 'heating' when valid then 'ok' else coalesce(invalid_reason, 'invalid') end as status
           from sauna_runs order by started_at desc limit 50

description: The heat-up experiment (docs/plan-sauna-heatup.md): heating mode first, then the vents. Data from sauna_runs and sauna_samples, written by iot-poll.py --poll-huum.
